name: flai-generated-files
description: Use when deciding whether to run build_runner, checking which files are auto-generated, or managing env variables in this Flutter project. Covers when to regenerate, committed vs gitignored files, and package constraints.

# Generated Files

## Files Committed to Git

`*.g.dart`, `*.freezed.dart` and `lib/gen/*.gen.dart` (flutter_gen typed assets) are committed.

Exception: `lib/core/env/env.g.dart` is **gitignored** (contains obfuscated secrets).

## When to Run Build Runner

Run after changing any file that uses:

| Annotation | Package |
|---|---|
| `@riverpod` / `@Riverpod` | `riverpod_generator` |
| `@freezed` | `freezed` |
| `@JsonSerializable` | `json_serializable` |
| `@RestApi` | `retrofit_generator` |
| `@Envied` | `envied_generator` |
| `@TypedGoRoute` | `go_router_builder` |
| `flutter: assets:` folders in `pubspec.yaml` (adding/removing files) | `flutter_gen_runner` → `lib/gen/assets.gen.dart` |

```sh
dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
```

Use assets through the generated class: `Assets.icons.foo.svg()`, `Assets.images.bar.image()`. See the `theme` skill.

## Env Variables

Defined in `.env` (gitignored). Access via `Env.baseUrl`, `Env.apiKey`.

After changing `.env`:

```sh
dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
```

## Freezed 3 Class Modifiers

freezed 3 requires an explicit class modifier:

| Shape | Declaration | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Single factory (data class) | `abstract class X with _$X` | `UserEntity`, `UserModel` |
| Several factories (union) | `sealed class X with _$X` | `Failure` |

- Add `const X._();` when the class declares getters/methods or mixes in another type (e.g. `PagedResponseMapper`).
- `when` / `map` exist again from freezed 3.1; prefer Dart `switch` pattern matching in new code.
- The mason bricks already emit `abstract class`.

## Package Constraints

| Package | Constraint | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `envied` | `>=1.1.0 <1.2.0` | Must match `envied_generator 1.1.1` |
| `freezed` / `freezed_annotation` | `^3.0.0` (resolves 3.1.x) | 3.2+ needs `build ^3` / `analyzer ≥9`, which the rest of the generator set does not support yet |
| `go_router_builder` | `">=3.0.0 <3.2.0"` | 3.2+ needs `build ^3`; keep in lockstep with freezed / riverpod_generator / retrofit_generator |
| `flutter_gen_runner` | `">=5.9.0 <5.10.0"` | Pinned to the version known to resolve with this generator set |

Do not upgrade `envied` past `1.1.x` without also upgrading `envied_generator`. Upgrade the generator set (freezed, go_router_builder, riverpod_generator, retrofit_generator, envied_generator, flutter_gen_runner) together, never one at a time.

Typed routes are generated by `go_router_builder` into `lib/core/router/app_router.g.dart`.

## Common Mistakes

- Forgetting to run build_runner after adding `@riverpod` → stale `.g.dart`, compile errors
- Committing `env.g.dart` → exposes obfuscated secrets, blocked by `.gitignore`
- Upgrading `envied` without `envied_generator` → generator version mismatch
- Declaring a single-factory freezed class as plain `class X with _$X` → freezed 3 build error; use `abstract class` (union → `sealed class`)
